GuidanceKind.description: The artifact kinds a mission type or step may reference: the guidance kinds. A mission type names roles, not agent profiles (ADR-0032).
GuidanceKind.title: GuidanceKind

Reference.description: A reference to guidance, stored verbatim; never minted as a relationship (#189).
Reference.title: Reference

Step.description: A step of the mission type, a sub-item of steps or on_demand_steps. Its prompt and guidelines are Markdown companions beside the mission-type file.

description.title: Description
description.description: The step's one-line, human-facing summary; a longer text is the prompt's detailed description (its frontmatter).

role.title: Role
role.description: An open role token, for example operator; absent when any role may act.

prompt_path.title: Prompt Path
prompt_path.description: Derived: steps/<id>.prompt.md. Present when the step has a prompt.

guidelines_path.title: Guidelines Path
guidelines_path.description: Derived: steps/<id>.guidelines.md. Present when the step has guidelines.

references.description: The step's action-scoped guidance, in authored order.
references.title: References

Step.title: Step

PathConventions.description: Directories in the mission's workspace, not pack files; at least one is named.
PathConventions.title: PathConventions

ExpectedInputArtifact.description: An artifact a step needs before it runs: a precondition, checked in the mission's workspace. It has no class and no template.

artifact_key.title: Artifact Key
artifact_key.description: An opaque dotted key, kept verbatim; not an identity: the same key may stand at two steps.

path_pattern.description: A glob in the mission's workspace, not a pack file: relative, no '..'.
path_pattern.title: Path Pattern

blocking.description: Present only when a missing input blocks the step; absent means not blocking.
blocking.title: Blocking

ExpectedInputArtifact.title: ExpectedInputArtifact

ExpectedOutputArtifact.description: An artifact a step or the mission produces: a postcondition, checked in the mission's workspace.

artifact_key.title: Artifact Key
artifact_key.description: An opaque dotted key, kept verbatim; not an identity: the same key may stand at two steps.

artifact_class.title: Artifact Class
artifact_class.description: What the artifact is to the mission; input is the mission's input document, such as the specification a specify step produces.

path_pattern.description: A glob in the mission's workspace, not a pack file: relative, no '..'.
path_pattern.title: Path Pattern

blocking.description: Present only when a missing artifact blocks the step; absent means not blocking.
blocking.title: Blocking

template_path.description: The template that produces the artifact, relative to the mission-type file.
template_path.title: Template Path

ExpectedOutputArtifact.title: ExpectedOutputArtifact

description: A mission type: its steps in order, the steps invoked on demand, its expected artifacts and its guidance (ADR-0044).

id.title: Id
id.description: The file stem; the file is missions/<id>/<id>.mission-type.yaml.

content.title: Content
content.description: Standing context for the agent of every step.

requires_substantive_spec.description: Present when the type requires a substantive specification; absent means not required, never 'use a default'.
requires_substantive_spec.title: Requires Substantive Spec

expected_output_artifacts.description: The mission's own postconditions, not tied to a step.
expected_output_artifacts.title: Expected Output Artifacts

references.description: The type's recipe ingredients, in authored order.
references.title: References

steps.description: The sequence: the list order is the run order.
steps.title: Steps

on_demand_steps.description: Steps invoked by an explicit command, outside the sequence; authored order kept, not a run order.
on_demand_steps.title: On-Demand Steps

title: MissionType
